Reseña de Taylor Slater: 'Hector is a true master of his craft. I handed him some rough drawings of a custom table and chairs, and he turned them into an absolutely stunning reality.'

services_evidence.category: Custom cabinetry & built-ins (closets, shoe cabinets, bookshelves)

Foto bk-8: deck de madera terminado en patio trasero. Reseña de Mary Strouse: 'I started with a request to replace the damaged boards and he was able to find a way to redo the whole deck in record time at reasonable cost.'

pricing_note: Negocio de carpinteria custom/por encargo (ebanisteria 1 de 1, 'Everything 1 of 1' segun su propia bio). No publica lista de precios fija en ningun canal (Google Business, Instagram): cada pieza se cotiza segun diseño, madera y dimensiones. Se usa framing 'se cotiza, escribenos' para las 4 categorias de servicio evidenciadas arriba.

reviewSamples.author: Mary Strouse
reviewSamples.text: Hector is an amazing carpenter. I started with a request to replace the damaged boards and he was able to find a way to redo the whole deck in record time at reasonable cost. I felt he treated my project as if he were working on his own property. I am so fortunate to have found such an honest and conscientious person.

reviewSamples.author: Taylor Slater
reviewSamples.text: Hector is a true master of his craft. I handed him some rough drawings of a custom table and chairs, and he turned them into an absolutely stunning reality. The craftsmanship is flawless and looks even better in person than it did in my head.

reviewSamples.author: Teresa Flores
reviewSamples.text: Hector is great. I called for him to make table legs for my wood table. I sent pics. And he knew exactly which legs to make. And match my wood perfectly. Amazing job. Today he came and made my shoe cabinet. It has a lot of pieces.

photos_note: 12 fotos reales descargadas del feed publico de Instagram @330customcarpentry via research_ig.py (bk-1 a bk-12) + logo.jpg (foto de perfil). Curaduria visual (contact sheet _sheet.jpg revisado imagen por imagen): se seleccionaron 5 para el site por ser trabajo terminado, buena luz, sin texto superpuesto ni clutter: bk-2 (mesa de madera maciza acabado live-edge, color naranja vibrante, usada como hero), bk-3 (silla de madera solida hecha a medida), bk-8 (deck de madera terminado en patio), bk-10 (closet corredizo a medida estilo shoji), bk-11 (set de formones/herramientas de carpintero, detalle de oficio). Se RECHAZARON: bk-1 (cuarto vacio oscuro, 'Before' con texto superpuesto), bk-4 y bk-5 (texto rosa superpuesto tipo meme/story), bk-6 (primer plano de reloj/muñeca, no es foto de carpinteria), bk-7 (selfie retrato del dueño, PROHIBIDO como tile de galeria), bk-9 (post de solo texto, sin imagen de trabajo), bk-12 (sala con clutter de cajas de mudanza).
brand_vibe: Taller de carpinteria/ebanisteria custom, estetica 'neobrutalism' auto-declarada en su bio, maderas calidas (maple, live-edge con vetas naranja/caoba), tonos tierra, acero de herramientas. Encaja con base OSCURA tipo taller/atelier (charcoal + acento madera/cobre calido), inspirada en template dark (Mizu) pero re-tintada a tonos madera/cobre en vez de dorado champagne.
